metadata.description: Verified catalogue import preview structured for the Phase 11.3 Variant Engine and D1 schema
metadata.pricing_rule_confirmed: Single-piece price from original WhatsApp price; Expected price per 100 from discounted price * 100; Special exception for Glass Sipper with Handle (₹275 MRP / ₹11,000 per 100); MOQ null unless explicitly specified.

owner_decisions_applied.categories_rule: Preserve 6 existing categories strictly. Do not create 7th category. Accessories remain unassigned and hidden from public catalogue until approved.
owner_decisions_applied.variant_engine_rule: Group related capacities as variants under family parent cards using Phase 11.3 variant engine (dual pricing in paise, active variant filtering, image fallback).
owner_decisions_applied.glass_sipper_exception: Item 4 (Glass Sipper with Handle 250ml) single price set to printed retail box MRP ₹275 (27,500 paise) instead of WhatsApp ₹299. Wholesale 100pcs remains ₹11,000 (1,100,000 paise).
owner_decisions_applied.prod_16_category_discrepancy: Documented: In local D1, prod-16 is erroneously set to 'glass-bottles'. In remote production backup, prod-16 is correctly set to 'ss-sippers'. Intended category is 'ss-sippers'. Neither database modified.
owner_decisions_applied.claims_verification_rule: Clearly distinguish manufacturer-stated claims (e.g. 24h thermal performance, BPA-free) from independently verified physical evidence (e.g. engraved 'YE SS 304', printed box MRP). Mark unsupported claims for owner confirmation.
